reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可见的聊天界面扩展：以联系人列表+会话区域的形式展示 AI 角色，并支持角色定义、头像生成与对话驱动的图片/视频交互。其功能核心集中在本地角色数据管理与配置、以及通过本地代理将会话与媒体生成请求转发到用户配置的外部 API，因此属于界面导航面板方向。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，将界面转为微信式 AI 角色聊天布局，支持本地保存人设与画像，并基于配置接口进行对话、发图和发视频等交互。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that changes the interface into a WeChat-style AI character chat layout, supports local persona/avatar data, and performs chat, image, and video actions via configured model APIs.

capabilities: Writes and reads persona markdown and generated portrait files in local DSH storage.
Stores user settings/API model selections in browser localStorage.
Proxies model requests through local `/girlfriend/*` routes to user-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Injects custom sidebar/contact and conversation UI components into the DSH web client.

reasons.code: README documents role/persona storage at `<DSH 主目录>/storages/girlfriend/<角色ID>.md` and `images/<角色ID>.png`, and startup reads these files to load settings.
README states the plugin configures a `/girlfriend/*` route that forwards `/chat/completions`, `/images/generations`, and `/videos/generations` traffic to configured model endpoints.
README notes API keys and settings are kept in browser localStorage under `dsh.girlfriend.*`.
Package metadata declares a web plugin with `dsh.client.platform: web` and exposes bundle patch + postinstall setup to add/enable the alternate profile.
